title: RRT Step Tracer
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: Robot Motion Planning
description: Grow a small RRT tree one step at a time: move a random point, see which node is nearest, and watch the new node appear one step toward the point. Then carry out the step by hand in six problems. Used in Chapter 19.

educational.topic: One step of the RRT sampling-based planning algorithm
learningObjectives: Execute one step of the RRT algorithm by hand, finding the distance to the nearest node and the coordinates of the new node, to within 0.1 of the unit shown, in six problems, with at least 5 of 6 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Carry out a three-part procedure by hand on easy numbers after watching it grow a tree
keyQuestions: Is the new node the random point?
Which node does a step start from: the newest or the nearest?
commonMisconceptions: The new node is the random point
The nearest node is the most recent one
The step moves the tree toward the goal
assessmentOpportunities: Six typed answers, one attempt each; 5 of 6 for mastery

controls.label: Drag or tap the random point on the grid
Next problem / See score / Try again
